rules: 20-chip heads-up Hold'em, 1/2 blinds, preset wager actions; alternating candidate seat and button
limitations: One direct match against one incumbent does not measure equilibrium proximity.
Normal interval is a screening approximation; replicate with further seeds before broad strength claims.
interpretation_note: This historical run moved a saved seat-1 policy into seat 0 for part of evaluation, while seat identity is an observation feature. It remains a measured result but cannot support promotion of the seat-specific deployed policy. See E068 and the corrected seat1/seat-specific files.
